theorems.name: Submission.doragm_sab_cutoff_mass_sandwich
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (A τ : ℝ), 0 < τ → (∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u ∧ φ u ≤ 1) → (∀ u, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) → (∀ u, A ≤ u → φ u = 0) → Integrable (fun x => φ (‖x - y‖ / τ)) μ → μ (closedBall y τ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) ∂μ) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) ∂μ) ≤ μ (closedBall y (A * τ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
